brief: A free live map of Indonesia showing flights, ships, satellites, earthquakes, volcano alert levels, fires, floods, rain radar and cameras. The name means to watch over. It should feel watchful, calm and trustworthy, and rooted in Indonesia.
criteria: Success: avoids the crosshair, radar and globe clichés, reads at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, feels calm rather than alarming.

concepts.name: Volcano Eye
concepts.idea: An eye whose upper lid is a volcano peak, watching over the land.
rationale: Pantau means to watch over, and the volcano roots it in Indonesia
One continuous outline with a lava coloured pupil, readable at 16 px with the small cut
Teal for calm and trust, lava apricot for the single point of attention

recommendation: Volcano Eye, chosen by the client. Use the small cut below 48 px and keep the pupil in lava apricot on light backgrounds.
next_steps: Follow the usage guide in design/logo/README.md
